title: Finite quotients of a discrete valuation ring with finite residue field

source.place: node def-weil-finite-field-fiber, order 411: 'For every finite extension $E/\Ql$, write $\mathcal O_E$ for its valuation ring, choose a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and, for every $n\geq1$, set $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$' (used there without proof); the claims ('$A_{E,n}$ is a finite local ring', 'the transition maps are surjective', '$A_{E,n}$ does not depend on the choice of $\varpi_E$') are made in def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension. No document in literature/ proves them; reference: J.-P. Serre, Local Fields, GTM 67 (wanted in literature/LIST.md, not obtained), Ch. I, §1 (ideals of a discrete valuation ring are the $\mathfrak m^n$) and Ch. II, §2
